title: The Sleeping House
author: Jonah Oyelaran
blurb: Hazel Ravensworth, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must get the family out ahead of the count before the well refills.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
